As computer scientists, engineers, and former entrepreneurs, we can get in the weeds with startup teams on technical challenges at any scale. And if we can't solve the problem or get the right answer, we leverage our relationships across the Alphabet ecosystem and find someone who can.

We invest in innovative founders across industries and optimize for ideas that demand long-term relationships — ones where we can provide value across multiple stages and milestones.
